 ‘We will take his manhood’: Former officer to be castrated after child rape conviction 
 Judge calls it the “worst case” of child sexual abuse he’s ever seen. 
 A former police officer and volunteer firefighter convicted of multiple child sex crimes received three life sentences and will be castrated, officials said. By Raley Pellittieri Published : Nov. 13, 2026 at 11:32 AM CST | Updated : Nov. 13, 2026 at 11:37 AM CST Share Add Us On Google Add as a preferred source on Google POINTE COUPEE PARISH, La. (WAFB) - A former New Roads police officer and volunteer firefighter convicted of raping multiple children received three life sentences and will be castrated, officials said. 
 Kedreyon K. Williams (Source: DA Tony Clayton's Office) According to District Attorney Tony Clayton, a jury in October convicted Kedreyon K. Williams, 31, of New Roads, of three counts of first-degree rape of juveniles, indecent behavior with a juvenile, and possession of pornography involving juveniles after only 39 minutes of deliberation. 
 Former New Roads cop, firefighter convicted of raping children; faces mandatory life in prison Former New Roads police officer arrested, accused of raping child While a rape conviction already carries a mandatory life sentence, the district attorney went a step further and sought physical castration. 
 At the sentencing, District Judge Kevin Kimball said that it was the “worst case” of child sexual abuse that he had seen. 
 According to the district attorney, “He performed disgusting acts on children who could not defend themselves. He is a child predator, and he deserves exactly what he is getting and more. The castration is another layer of punishment for these horrendous crimes.” 
 “If a man takes sexual advantage of a child, and we will take his manhood!” Clayton said. “We hope the families know that justice was served here and have some comfort in knowing he will never be able to prey on any children again.”
